'''TR-522''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I was one of the grunts stationed at this forward post before it all began. Watched my whole squad get sick, die and then stand up hungry.|TR-522, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DSB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Deliver Stun Baton|Dathomir}}</ref>}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], stormtrooper TR-522 was stationed on the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. He was based in a small forward post that was part of the defensive system of the secret [[Imperial Research and Prison Facility]]. TR-522 used to wear a black [[Imperial Spec Ops Officer armor]].<ref name="SWG:DSB" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> an [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir|accident]] took place in the Imperial Research and Prison Facility. The [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]] that was studied there escaped containment and decimated most of the people in the area, turning them into starving [[Zombie/Legends|undead]] creatures.<ref name="SWG:MMR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Mysterious Meeting Request|Dathomir}}</ref> In TR-522's forward post, all the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] stationed there during the outbreak were infected and turned into zombies. Only TR-522 appeared to be immunized to the virus and barely escaped the undeads by fighting his former fellow strormtroopers with his [[Stun baton/Legends|stun baton]].<ref name="SWG:DSB" />

[[File:Camp_Delta_Dathomir.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Camp Delta]] in the [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|Quarantine Zone]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].]]

In response, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] promptly established a [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|Quarantine Zone]] to contain the infection.<ref name="SWG:MMR" /> The few people who survived the initial virus outbreak, including TR-522,<ref name="SWG:DSB" /> were trapped in the Quarantine Zone. The survivors established camps in order to to repel the regular assaults of the zombies and try to live in safety while waiting for an evacuation.<ref name="SWG:MMR" /> TR-522 took shelter in [[Camp Delta]], his former forward post,<ref name="SWG:DSB" /> along with Imperial [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Erlem Marh]]<ref name="SWG:FWDC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Forward Watch, Delta Camp}}</ref> and the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Oona Wran]].<ref name="SWG:DCACD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Destroy Canisters Around Camp Delta|Dathomir}}</ref>

Later, a spacer arrived at Camp Delta and delivered a [[Radionics|radio]] to TR-522. The radio was provided by the [[TIE pilot|Imperial pilot]] [[Jeb Maris]] in [[Camp Alpha]] who had decided to establish communications between the camps. Once radios were delivered to the five camps in the Quarantine Zone, the survivors were able to safely coordinate high altitude supply drops sent from outside the Quarantine Zone.<ref name="SWG:DR" />

==Behind the scenes==
TR-522 was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> TR-522 was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 14|Game Update 14]]," a.k.a. the [[W:c:swg:Death Troopers|"Death Troopers" update]], released on [[October 12]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 14: Death Troopers">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1008376|text=Game Update 14: Death Troopers}}</ref>
